decisions.reason: Waiting for missing parts before adding the sensor board to the order does not change the required BOM content or board-specific BOM requirement.
The ordering condition does not alter the requirement to verify component orientations in JLCPCB.
Deferring addition of the sensor board to the combined order does not change which production export files are required.
The source addresses when to add the sensor board to the order; it does not revise the component sourceability policy or select replacement parts.
The sensor-board ordering condition has no effect on connector pin-label content or placement.
Adding the sensor board to a later manufacturing order does not change its interboard power topology, connector type, or pinout.
The manufacturing-order timing does not alter standalone USB power behavior or powered loads.
The source changes only when the sensor board is added to the order, not its connector-hub role or connector matrix.
The ordering condition does not modify connector placement, alignment, orientation, or cable-routing requirements.
Referring to the sensor board as the fourth order item does not change the established three-board product architecture or board roles.
Waiting for parts before ordering does not change the requirement that all sensor-board content fit on the board.
The sensor-board order timing does not change current logic-level compatibility, omitted level-shifter footprints, or future adapter use.
